entries.columnsContract: `review_id PK, libra_run_id FK, subject_id FK, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, record_schema_ref, record_json, record_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；Libra通过明确资料查询命令取得Provider候选并保存完整Review，schema固定`libra.episode-metadata-review-record@1`，JSON上限`3 MiB`；绑定Run revision/execution basis、resolved identity、本地材料集合、期望mapping revision及完整候选证据；GET只读已保存Review

entries.columnsContract: `intent_id PK, review_id FK, libra_run_id FK, subject_id FK, mapping_revision INTEGER, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, record_schema_ref, record_json, record_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`UNIQUE(subject_id,mapping_revision)`、`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；schema固定`libra.episode-metadata-mapping-record@1`，JSON上限`1 MiB`；显式用户选择产生完整版本，条目绑定Review证据，不能直接提交Provider内容；同事务写head/Receipt/Marker/Audit，陈旧Run/identity/material/head或已交付拒绝

entries.columnsContract: `subject_id PK FK, current_revision INTEGER, intent_id FK, record_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: 每Subject当前映射head；expected revision CAS且连续递增；仅对完整identity/material basis一致的后续Run有效；不因整个Subject保留而进入Reset保留集合，只保留已入藏执行明确依赖的Intent及Review

entries.columnsContract: `preview_id PK, subject_id FK, libra_run_id FK, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, record_schema_ref, record_json, record_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`；schema固定`libra.custom-target-preview@1`，closed JCS JSON上限`64 KiB`；preview_id及record_digest均为完整previewDigest，绑定精确Run/Spec/decision head/Shelf Standard/identity/material/product scope与当前custom revision；只保存用户实际可确认的要求及证据，不产生执行资格

entries.columnsContract: `intent_id PK, preview_id FK, subject_id FK, libra_run_id FK, product_scope_digest, target_revision INTEGER, actor_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, record_schema_ref, record_json, record_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`UNIQUE(actor_id,idempotency_key)`及`UNIQUE(subject_id,product_scope_digest,target_revision)`及`UNIQUE(intent_id,subject_id,product_scope_digest,target_revision,record_digest)`；schema固定`libra.custom-target-intent@1`，closed JCS JSON上限`64 KiB`；target_revision从1连续；只确认preview实际展示的子集且保留全部原始基线/要求/证据。意图不是Spec发布、生产完成或Arca接纳事实；旧执行输入不得原地修改。已入藏依赖通过冻结的精确Intent与Preview闭包保留，不保留同Subject的其他历史

entries.columnsContract: `subject_id PK FK, product_scope_digest PK, current_revision INTEGER, intent_id FK, record_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: 按Subject与精确产品范围的当前指针；expected revision/intent/digest CAS连续递增，首次logical revision为0；head与Intent的subject/scope/revision复合FK必须一致。跨Owner公开Projection在事务外读取，Foundation opaque read fence在BEGIN IMMEDIATE后且Owner写入前验证；幂等Receipt重放先于新鲜度检查，不把Arca/Perception Repository加入Libra事务。不保留旧head来代替已入藏精确依赖

entries.columnsContract: `analysis_id PK FK, libra_run_id FK UNIQUE, subject_id FK, completion_schema_ref, completion_json, completion_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable完成事实；schema固定UsAdultMatchCompletion，JSON上限`256 KiB`；analysis_id指同Run的Analysis Basis；完整匹配Result集digest、页数、检测脸数、胜者版本及原Result引用冻结；无胜者是明确正常结果，不以未完成或失败页替代；不因People编辑重算

entries.columnsContract: `workspace_id FK, workspace_revision, state, material_reference_set_digest, transition_kind(admitted|reference_attached|product_staged|reference_released|reclaiming|reclaimed), transition_evidence_digest, previous_revision NULL, revision_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(workspace_id,workspace_revision)`；append-only且从1连续；`workspace_id`到`libra_workspaces`的普通父FK保持immediate，配合上述固定aggregate-first插入顺序消除首次建立循环；current Workspace row由最高revision重建，set digest来自每个handle最高Reference revision

entries.columnsContract: `workspace_id FK, libra_run_id FK, reference_id, material_handle_id, material_key, workspace_handle_schema_ref, workspace_handle_json, workspace_handle_digest, reference_revision, reference_state(working|product_staging|released), episode_claims_schema_ref, episode_claims_json, episode_scope_digest, product_verification_schema_ref NULL, product_verification_id NULL, product_verification_json NULL, product_verification_digest NULL, previous_reference_revision NULL, committed_workspace_revision, reference_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(reference_id,reference_revision)`及`UNIQUE(workspace_id,material_handle_id,reference_revision)`；typed Handle JSON固定`WorkspaceMaterialHandle@1`且≤`4 KiB`，Episode claims JSON固定`LibraWorkspaceEpisodeClaims@1`且≤`16 KiB`，完整保存`0..32`项本节typed Episode claim并重算同一scope digest；Handle必须与`fx_workspace_materials.handle_schema_ref/json/digest/fence_digest`及Decision逐字节一致后冻结，允许Foundation material后来reclaimed仍重建历史Reference。Verification四列在working全NULL；product_staging全非NULL且schema固定role-aware `WorkspaceProductVerificationSnapshot@1`、canonical JSON≤`128 KiB`、ID/digest逐字节匹配；released逐字节沿用前一revision四列：由working释放时全NULL，由product_staging释放时全非NULL，不能清空或替换。每次Reference transition与同一事务Workspace revision一一绑定，历史Workspace revision N按`committed_workspace_revision<=N`选择每个stream最高Reference revision重建set；每个reference stream从1连续、append-only，最高revision是current；同一stream后续revision的Handle、materialKey与Episode claims逐字节沿用；同一Workspace最多1024个current non-released Reference且同一materialKey至多一个，防止Cleanup无法形成完整Scope或hard-link Handle对同一Control重复release；released不得再回到前态；同一handle不能同时存在两个current role；只引用同Workspace的`fx_workspace_materials`，Artifact分支还必须精确命中`fx_artifact_registry`中的immutable Handle

entries.columnsContract: `cleanup_scope_id PK, libra_run_id FK, workspace_id FK, trigger_kind(offload_completed|run_superseded|run_discarded|run_administratively_retired), trigger_ref, trigger_revision, trigger_digest, admission_record_schema_ref, admission_record_json, admission_decision_digest, eligibility_evidence_digest, member_set_digest, state(active|completed|blocked), state_revision, state_digest, created_at_ms, completed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(trigger_kind,trigger_ref,trigger_revision,trigger_digest)`；Admission Record typed JSON≤`64 KiB`保存除relationized members外的完整Decision，和member rows合并后必须重建同一Decision/digest；current row为`cas_lifecycle`，active/blocked的completed time为NULL；只由Discard或Cleanup Scope Admission事务建立；`INDEX(state,created_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `cleanup_scope_id FK, material_handle_id, material_key, workspace_reference_id, expected_reference_revision, expected_reference_digest, control_disposition(uncontrolled|libra_owned|other_owned), expected_control_revision, expected_control_projection_digest, expected_control_owner_domain NULL, expected_control_owner_scope_type NULL, expected_control_owner_scope_id NULL, cleanup_kind(delete_or_verify_absent), state(pending|completed|blocked), state_revision, state_digest, committed_scope_state_revision NULL, deletion_effect_id NULL, outcome_evidence_schema_ref NULL, outcome_evidence_id NULL, outcome_evidence_json NULL, outcome_evidence_digest NULL, cleanup_receipt_id NULL, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(cleanup_scope_id,material_handle_id)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`且只允许expected `pending→completed|blocked`；每项都保存完整available Control Projection revision/digest，uncontrolled的owner列全NULL，两个owned variant全非NULL且分别要求ownerDomain=libra或非libra；pending的committed/effect/evidence/receipt列全NULL；terminal Evidence typed JSON≤`16 KiB`，completed固定`WorkspaceMaterialDeletionEvidence@1`，blocked固定`WorkspaceCleanupBlockingEvidence@1`；libra_owned的released Control revision严格为expected+1并由historical Control row重建Receipt，other_owned不得主动删除或释放Control、只允许already-absent Evidence，blocked不得释放Reference或Control。Scope revision history由每个member唯一`committed_scope_state_revision`排序，与初始revision 1确定性重建，禁止later current row覆盖历史；`INDEX(state,updated_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id PK, libra_run_id FK, fact_kind, fact_revision, aggregate_id NULL, schema_ref, fact_json, episode_metadata_schema_ref NULL, episode_metadata_json NULL, fact_digest, evidence_digest, source_basis_kind(decision_evidence|metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match|us_adult_actor) NULL, source_basis_id NULL, source_basis_digest NULL, source_ref_count, verified_artifact_manifest_schema_ref NULL, verified_artifact_manifest_json NULL, verified_artifact_manifest_digest NULL, artifact_verification_result_count, commit_payload_schema_ref NULL, commit_payload_digest NULL, event_fence_digest NULL, commit_marker NULL FK UNIQUE, result_digest NULL, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `fact_kind`必须是Catalog已注册的Product Fact kind，不由Store发明open value；Fact JSON上限`64 KiB`且大Artifact只含handle。`resolved_identity|media_cast|product_metadata`按8.6.19固定`product_fact_id/aggregate_id/revision/commit/evidence/result`，要求全部commit/Source Basis列非NULL。Resolved Identity只允许`decision_evidence`且`source_ref_count=1`，同事务还必须建立Subject Identity revision/current pointer及全部exact continuity relations。Product Metadata只允许`metadata_observation|western_analysis`，且三个Artifact Manifest列全非NULL、schema固定`VerifiedArtifactManifest@1`、canonical JSON≤`256 KiB`、digest逐字节等于Manifest `manifestDigest`，`artifact_verification_result_count`等于items中去重后的显式verification Result ID数并为`0..256`；Media Cast只允许`metadata_observation|western_match`，三个Manifest列全NULL且该count=0。Observation basis的`source_ref_count=1..16`；Western Product Metadata basis为`2..17`（至少一项Analysis Result加恰一项Normalize Result）；Western Media-Cast basis恰为1项Match Result。其他已注册kind继续服从各自既有精确合同，允许这些PBF-14专用列为NULL且两个count=0，不能被本修正反向套用未定义公式；非NULL `commit_marker`显式FK到`fx_commit_markers(commit_marker)`，`ON DELETE RESTRICT`且唯一，`result_digest`逐字节等于marker所指`fx_event_result_bindings`；`UNIQUE(libra_run_id,fact_kind,fact_revision)`；`INDEX(libra_run_id,fact_kind,fact_revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `product_fact_id FK, ordinal, source_basis_kind(decision_evidence|metadata_observation|western_analysis|western_match|us_adult_actor), work_id FK, attempt_id FK, plan_id FK, event_id FK, result_id FK, capability_ref, result_schema_ref, result_digest, source_ref, source_order, evidence_id NULL, evidence_digest NULL, input_binding_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(product_fact_id,ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(product_fact_id,result_id)`；ordinal从0连续且恰等于Fact row的`source_ref_count`，`source_order=ordinal`，全部Work/Attempt/Plan/Event必须构成同一Run、同一Execution Basis；`result_schema_ref`逐字节复制对应Capability manifest的result contract ref（该contract必须以`$ref`唯一指向下述领域typed Result），领域payload自己的`schemaRef`再独立逐字节校验；所有`result_digest`都逐字节复制对应`fx_event_result_bindings.result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(包含领域内digest字段的完整typed Result))`，不得复制Result内部排除自身计算的领域摘要；`input_binding_digest=SHA-256(JCS(fx_plan_nodes.input_bindings_json解析后的完整typed value))`。`decision_evidence`恰包含Product Identity Event的Decision Evidence实际引用的有界Query Result链；Movie/Series固定为一项`libra.product_identity.evidence.observe@1 → ProductIdentityEvidenceObservation@1`且只接受唯一resolved Provider identity；Series须同时命中Plan Owner binding冻结的Season、Run Episode claims的season_claim_digest、完整Observation/identity digest与provider_season_identity Evidence，不允许Related claim直接发布Fact，`source_ref`固定为Decision Evidence ID，Evidence列复制该Observation的Evidence ID/payload digest，且Query Result、Decision Evidence、Resolved Identity、Source Basis和同Run Subject必须一致；`libra.product_identity.resolve@1`在同一`domain_fact_commit` Event内原子形成Resolved Identity、Subject identity revision、Product Fact、Source refs、Result与marker，不允许先发布无Owner Fact的游离Resolution Result；`metadata_observation`固定`libra.product_metadata.fetch@1 → MetadataObservation@1`，`source_ref=MetadataObservation.sourceRef`，按`sourcePriority,evidence_id`排序且Evidence列非NULL；`western_analysis`固定一至16项`libra.western.analysis.observe@1 → WesternAnalysisResult@1`后恰一项`libra.western.metadata.normalize@1 → ProductMetadataDraft@1`，observe的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisResult.resultArtifactHandle.artifactHandleId`且该Handle/digest逐字节命中同Run Artifact Registry row，Evidence列非NULL；normalize的`source_ref=WesternAnalysisVariant.variantId`且Evidence列全NULL；normalize Plan input必须显式引用前序Result且最后Result逐字节等于Commit Draft；`western_match`恰一项`shared.face.reference.match@1 → PersonMatchEvidence@1`且`source_ref=PersonMatchEvidence.evidenceId`、Evidence列非NULL，其matches可为空但必须来自真实Frame→Embedding→Cluster→Match链。`reference_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-fact-source-ref@1",productFactId,ordinal,sourceBasisKind,workId,attemptId,planId,eventId,resultId,capabilityRef,resultSchemaRef,resultDigest,sourceRef,sourceOrder,evidenceId,evidenceDigest,inputBindingDigest}))`；relation存在期间所指Foundation链及Western Artifact Registry row不得GC；不得用later current Result替换历史引用
